net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.domain.dto.result
Data-transfer objects that model web and generic search results from the Brave Search API.
net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.domain.dto.result.search
Data-transfer objects that model the container and rich components of a web search response.
net.ygbstudio.jbrave.core.domain.dto.web
Data-transfer objects that model rich web result types returned by the Brave Search API.
